deals.structure: Multi-year cloud capacity (Stargate sites) widely reported at ~$300B over ~5 years starting 2027.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Oracle RPO reached $664B at 31 Aug 2026 (company-reported); OpenAI share is analyst estimate, not company-disclosed. Reported scale-back: planned 600 MW Abilene expansion cancelled, capping Abilene at 1.2 GW.
deals.notes: Oracle has not itself named OpenAI's contract value in the sources retrieved; $300B is press-reported. Nvidia 10-Q separately notes a $105B guarantee cap for an OpenAI affiliate leasing at an SB Energy campus (see nvidia-sbenergy-guarantee).

deals.structure: Incremental $250B Azure commitment; Microsoft gave up right of first refusal as compute provider.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Part of Oct 2025 recapitalization. Microsoft FY27 Q1 10-Q headline: commercial RPO +73% to $677B (OpenAI share not isolated in text retrieved).
deals.notes: Multi-year, no stated end date in retrieved text. Time frame unverified.

deals.structure: About 27% as-converted diluted stake after recap (previously 32.5%), valued ~$135B at the time; equity-method accounting; IP rights through 2032; revenue share continues until AGI verified by expert panel but paid over longer period.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Stake diluted further by 2026 rounds is likely but not confirmed in retrieved filing text.
deals.notes: Headline 13 is Microsoft's earlier funding commitments (10-Q), not the stake value.

deals.structure: Original $38B multi-year deal (Nov 2025) expanded Feb 2026 by $100B over 8 years incl. ~2 GW Trainium capacity.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Expanded in Feb 2026 together with Amazon's equity investment.
deals.notes: Record both: $38B original, +$100B incremental over 8 years (total $138B per press arithmetic).

deals.structure: $15B initial then $35B later on conditions; part of the 2026 round. Press (secondary) reports conditions tied to IPO/AGI, not confirmed by companies.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Secondary report says the investment was fully funded by Q3 2026; not confirmed from filing text I retrieved.
deals.notes: Circularity: investor is also a $138B cloud vendor to OpenAI.

deals.structure: Sept 2025 LOI for up to $100B (tied to 10 GW) reportedly replaced by ~$30B direct equity investment in the 2026 round.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Original $100B LOI never finalized (per secondary reports); Nvidia 10-Q does not disclose OpenAI investment amount in the text retrieved.
deals.notes: $30B figure from press and OpenAI round reporting.

deals.structure: Nvidia guarantees capped at $105B for leases of ~4.25 GW IT load at SB Energy's PORTS campus (Pike County, Ohio) on behalf of an OpenAI affiliate; effective on lease commencement, first phase expected FY2029; terminate if OpenAI achieves satisfactory credit rating; option for ~3.8 GW more.
deals.notes: A cap, not a current liability; no payments expected until leases commence.

deals.structure: 6 GW Instinct GPUs; AMD issued OpenAI warrant for up to 160M shares at $0.01 vesting with deployment/price milestones.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: First 1 GW slated H2 2026; no 2026 status update verified.
deals.notes: Dollar value not disclosed by companies; press estimates vary. Warrant means chip vendor pays OpenAI in equity.

deals.structure: 10 GW custom accelerators + Ethernet, deployment H2 2026 through 2029; financial terms undisclosed.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Broadcom CEO reportedly expects little OpenAI revenue in 2026.
deals.notes: No dollar headline from the companies.

deals.structure: 750 MW across tranches through 2028; reported >$10B.
~$22.4B across contracts (lead). Not re-verified in 2026 sources; CoreWeave Q3 2026 backlog $132.5B total, customer split not retrieved.
deals.notes: CoreWeave stock held by OpenAI not re-verified.

deals.structure: Altman cited ~$1.4T over ~8 years (Nov 2025). OpenAI reportedly told investors in Feb 2026 it targets ~$600B total compute spend by 2030.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Headline cut ~57% per press reports from anonymous sources; not an official statement.
deals.notes: Record both. Distinguishes contractual commitments from spend targets; the two are not identical.

deals.structure: $122B committed capital at $852B post-money; includes ~$3B from retail investors via banks.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Grew from $110B announced Feb 2026 at $730B pre-money.
deals.notes: 'Committed' not all funded at close; tranches conditional (e.g., Amazon).

deals.structure: Reported up to $30B at $1.25T pre-money, UAE-led; later reports say ~$11B first tranche, $15-20B total.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Size cut from target; valuation reportedly lowered from earlier $1.4T talk.
deals.notes: Based on unnamed sources; not confirmed by OpenAI. Confidential IPO filing reported June 2026.

deals.structure: $30B in 2026 round; cumulative ~$54.6B-$64.6B reported depending on date; carried at ~$99.6B fair value at 30 Sep 2026.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Financed by $40B bridge loan (repaid by mid-Sep 2026 via term loan, bonds, Arm margin loan), Arm-backed margin loan upsized to $25B, OpenAI-share-backed ~$6-10B margin loan, record yen retail bond.
deals.notes: Sources conflict on cumulative figure and margin loan size; SoftBank reported first quarterly loss in ~2 years (~JPY1.12T) in Sep 2026 quarter driven by power-equipment write-off and Intel hedges.

deals.structure: Multi-GW next-gen TPU capacity from 2027 (Broadcom filing: 3.5 GW, supply through 2031); builds on Oct 2025 >1 GW deal.
deals.notes: No dollar value disclosed; Broadcom said consumption depends on Anthropic's commercial success.

deals.structure: $30B Azure commitment up to 1 GW; Nvidia up to $10B and Microsoft up to $5B investment in Anthropic.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Later rounds: $30B Series G at $380B (Feb 2026), $65B Series H at $965B (May 2026) per secondary sources.
deals.notes: Series G/H not confirmed from primary source by me.

deals.structure: $50B US infrastructure plan, initially with Fluidstack on Google TPUs; Google reportedly provides credit backstop on Fluidstack leases.
~$40B package to buy Nvidia chips via off-balance-sheet SPV leasing to SpaceX; reportedly $32B bonds sold at 8.26% (20 Nov 2026) plus bank loans.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Earlier xAI arrangement reportedly failed sale-leaseback treatment, ~$13B debt recognized. SpaceX acquired xAI in all-stock deal Feb 2026.
deals.notes: Status of close conflicting across sources.

deals.structure: Series C EUR1.7B at EUR11.7B (Sep 2025, ASML-led); reported Series D EUR3B at >EUR20B (Sep 2026); ~$830M debt for Paris data center (Mar 2026).
deals.notes: Series D and debt from secondary sources only.
